# truenas_system_dataset (Data Source)

Reads the current TrueNAS system dataset configuration (the dataset that holds core system state such as logs, reporting, syslog, and samba4 data). Takes no arguments: there is exactly one system dataset configuration per TrueNAS system.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `basename` (String) Base path of the system dataset (e.g. "tank/.system").
- `id` (String) Fixed identifier for this singleton: always "system_dataset".
- `path` (String) Filesystem path the system dataset is mounted at (e.g. "/var/db/system").
- `pool` (String) Name of the pool the system dataset lives on.
- `pool_set` (Boolean) Whether the system dataset pool has been explicitly set.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the system dataset.
